title: Neutrino Binding Manifest
description: T0/T2: the realized-translation input that binds a capability's late-bound (to_be_bound) slots to concrete runtimes at realization time — distinct from the Binding Policy (declared in the capability) and the agent-side Binding Receipt. schemaVersion 1 is the L1 core (org/participant/slot/runtime/assurance/binder). schemaVersion 2 adds the optional L3 surface (): an l2Ref to the L2 interface, a backendProfile, and per-binding parameterBindings/derivedConcepts/evidenceRefs/compensation/observability/retryTimeout/deferred. The L3 fields are additive, so a v1 manifest is unchanged and existing consumers are unaffected. validate_binding_manifest.py is the fail-closed gate: it rejects an unknown triple, a fixed (non-bindable) slot, a runtime outside allowedRuntimes, an assurance below minAssurance, a wrong binder, an incomplete binding set, and (for v2) a parameter not declared by L2, a missing required L2 parameter, a type mismatch, an unsupported backend-profile field, or an untraceable derived concept — and emits a machine-readable status (complete | simulation-only | deferred | invalid). It also enforces that v1 manifests carry no L3 fields.

l2Ref.description: L3 (): link to the L2 domain-semantics interface whose declared parameters/concepts the bindings must trace to. Required when schemaVersion is 2; capability must equal the manifest capability.

artifact.description: Repo-relative path to the L2 interface artifact.

backendProfile.description: L3 (): id of a profile in the backend-profile catalog; constrains which optional hook fields a binding may use.

organizationId.description: Must equal the slot's organization in the binding-topology (null for an unscoped org).

slotId.description: The to_be_bound slotId from the binding-topology.

runtime.description: Realized runtime family; must be in the slot's allowedRuntimes.

assurance.description: Realized assurance tier; must be >= the slot's minAssurance.

binder.description: Org binding the slot; must equal the slot's authorizedBinder.

parameterBindings.description: L3 (): L2-parameter-name -> {type, value}. Each key must be an L2-declared parameter and its type must match the L2 declaration.

derivedConcepts.description: L3 (): L2 concepts/parameters this binding derives from; each must trace to the L2 interface.

evidenceRefs.description: L3 (): evidence requirement DECLARATIONS (not runtime verification — M4 verifies actual evidence).

compensation.description: L3 (): optional compensation hook; allowed only if the backend profile supports it.

deferred.description: L3 (): the binding is intentionally not yet realized (drives status: deferred).
